hostedRoute: Optional registered ios-ci.yml workflow_dispatch on exact V30 branch head only. Verify branch tip immediately before dispatch; accept diagnostic evidence only for matching run head_sha and complete checksummed artifacts. Never query Phase 10 runs or install workflows on main.
recoveryLaw: If an exact-ref/head/input candidate is active, wait for that candidate. Reuse a completed green matching diagnostic with complete required evidence.
Inspect terminal failures and complete logs/artifacts. Retain run ID, URL, head, selector, failure diagnosis and checksums append-only; missing evidence is not a pass.

For transient infrastructure failure, dispatch one fresh-runner candidate at the same exact authorized branch/head/inputs. Never rerun a failed run ID or weaken commands, watchdogs, selectors or artifact gates.

For diagnosed current-card product failure, append one direct-child correction with the same logical card ID and correctionOf prior head; preserve all failed/superseded candidates and rerun affected diagnostics.
Only exact current-card paths may be corrected. If the causal path is outside the fence, retain the hold/diagnosis and do not expand scope.

Unavailable optional diagnostics are NOT_EXECUTED_NO_NATIVE_CREDIT and do not prevent otherwise valid static provisional coding. Mandatory post-S10 qualification must re-run invalidated evidence on accepted S.
selectionLaw: Only current-card explicitly fenced Swift test classes; one UI class for P12/F25; no UI for N8. Task and nested typed selector must agree. WINDOWS_STATIC disables dispatch. Selector replacement is current-card-owned and cannot alter route pins.
windowsRoute: Deterministic Python static contract/selector/fence validation and source inspection; no xcodebuild or Simulator claims.
